propositions: The codebase accumulates 179 actionable RUF diagnostics (primarily RUF059, RUF022, RUF012, RUF005, RUF043, RUF023) that must be remediated before enabling the RUF rule family globally.
RUF001, RUF002, and RUF003 (Unicode-related) must be permanently deferred via [tool.ruff.lint].ignore without using extend-ignore or per-file-ignores.
The ratchet test must verify RUF is selected, exactly three codes are ignored, extend-ignore is absent, and per-file-ignores contains no RUF selectors or codes.
Safe mechanical Ruff fixes must be reviewed and unsafe fixes manually resolved across src/rebar and tests to eliminate all enabled RUF diagnostics.
After remediation and full rule-set configuration, ruff check must exit 0 and confirm no stale RUF100 noqa directives remain under the complete linting rule set.
